skill: Wreck (Крушение) with Anchor Slam (Удар якорем) merged in
concept: A fast series of three heavy blows with the anchor swung ON ITS CHAIN like a flail: swing 1 right-to-left, backhand swing 2 left-to-right, then the anchor goes over the head in a vertical arc and slams into the ground in front, sending a water wave along a lane. The anchor is physical: weight, inertia, chain taut in the swings, sagging in the pauses, impact bounce. Owner taste: sharp and fast, organic body, no slow wind-ups.

hands.now_in_game: Wreck clips Pelag_AN_WreckA/WreckB/WreckFinish (Resources/Characters/Pelag_v5/Mixamo, states WreckA_v5.. driven by TempoPhase). The anchor head is posed by code (PelagAnchorSlamView.Wreck.cs PoseWreck/WreckPayout) on 0.9-1.98 m of authored chain payout plus 0.42 m ring allowance (HeadSize 0.94, never below the stowed 1.31 m), like a flail. Main chain: LEFT hand (PelagEquipmentView.ChainGripPosition) -> anchor ring. RIGHT hand (ChainSupportPosition) holds the chain as a support: a 0.52-1.12 m bridge runs right hand -> left hand, a feed segment belt -> right hand. Nobody holds the shank. Swing contact 2.25 m in front of the root at 0.68 m height; the finisher lifts the head to 2.15 m (0.5 m forward, 0.35 m left) and drops it to 0.28 m. Sabre in the sash at the left hip (SetSlamOwnership -> BeginAnchorUse). Anchor Slam: AnchorSlam_v5, physical head on the chain (PelagAnchorSlamView.Physics). Source blend ART/PELAG/animation/anchor-slam/Pelag_Weighted_Combat_Work.blend no longer exists.
hands.sheet: Both hands on the chain only: left fist on the leather-wrapped grip with the chain running from it to the anchor, right fist on the chain right next to it (matches ChainGripPosition / ChainSupportPosition). Anchor about half his height on a dark iron chain about as long as he is tall (~1.5-2 m), never held by the shank. Sabre tucked in the red sash at the left hip in every figure.
hands.build_implication: No anchor-in-hand mode: keep the chain topology of the current view; body clips from sheets B/B2, anchor and chain motion physical per artifacts/wreck/anchor-tech (DESIGN.md pending, do not redesign it here). Two mismatches of the current PoseWreck against the sheet and the Sim comment («справа, обратный слева»): (1) stroke 1 sweeps the head from the left (-75 deg) through the front to +52 deg right, i.e. mirrored — the sheet is right, the staging must flip; (2) the finisher raises the head above and slightly in front, the sheet carries it over from behind the head (physical flail arc).

pose_numbers.1: ready: both hands on the chain grip at the right hip, anchor hanging and swinging low behind him to the right on the chain, weight on the back right foot, left foot forward, torso coiled right
pose_numbers.2: swing 1 contact, right to left: arms pull the chain across the body, chain taut, anchor flat at hip height ~2 m ahead-left, hips and chest turned left together, weight on the front left foot
pose_numbers.3: link: momentum carries the anchor on around behind him to the left, chain whipping in an arc, hands at the left hip, torso coiled left, short step with the right foot
pose_numbers.4: swing 2 contact, backhand left to right: chain taut, anchor flat at hip height ~2 m ahead-right, hips and chest turned right, weight on the front right foot
pose_numbers.5: overhead: arms raised, the anchor on the taut chain in a vertical arc high above and behind the head, chest open, left foot stepped forward, no jump
pose_numbers.6: slam: arms yanked down and forward, chain taut and straight, anchor crashed into the ground ~2 m ahead, deep lunge on the front left foot, back straight, lean ~40 deg
pose_numbers.7: recovery: chain pulled back, the anchor has dragged to his front foot, chain slack and sagging, wide balanced stance
pose_numbers.8: Ninth Wave (Девятый вал) hold: whirls the anchor overhead in a wide horizontal circle on the taut chain, arms raised, very low wide stance
pose_numbers.9: Ninth Wave release: bigger deeper slam, chain at full length, anchor buried far ahead, back knee almost on the ground
pose_numbers.10: Water Shell (Водяной панцирь): swing 2 (backhand) at contact in a wider, lower, rooted stance, feet flat, chin down
pose_numbers.11: Breakwater (Волнорез) drag: steps through after the anchor right after the slam, arms forward-down on the taut chain, the anchor ploughing forward along the ground by its own momentum, lean ~40 deg
